dct_title_s: South Pacific Ocean : New Caledonia. Southeastern Part : Port Nepui to Isle of Pines
dct_alternative_sm: Port Nepui (Mueo) to Isle of Pines
dct_description_sm: Depths shown by soundings; heights by hachures and spot heights.
Includes tidal information, 2 profile views, inset chart.
Shows shoals, reefs, drainage, coastal relief, small islands.
"Port Noumea Flagstaff is assumed to be in 166°26ʹ07ʺE and the longitudes of all points on thsi chart should therefore be decreased about 1'03"."
[Inset charts] : Port Nepui (Port Mueo) / From a French survey in 1876 -- Moindu Bay (Mara Bay) / From a French Survey in 1874
